title: UVA Data Science Colloquium
text:
The UVA School of Data Science Colloquium is a talk series to communicate research relevant to data science, broadly defined. If you are interested in giving a talk or suggesting a speaker, contact our current organizers: Tom Hartvigsen and YY Anh.
If you would like to receive talk announcements, please subscribe to our mailing list: sds-colloquium at virginia.edu.
